label: OpenRouter Model
description: Pick an OpenRouter model to serve LLM calls, on the connection an OpenRouter Access node holds; wire the provider output into any LLM node, one model node for however many calls.

inputs.name: access
inputs.description: The OpenRouter connection: wire an OpenRouter Access node's `access`.

inputs.name: servingProvider
inputs.label: Serving provider
inputs.description: Serve the model from one specific OpenRouter provider (anthropic, fireworks, amazon-bedrock, ...). Leave empty to let OpenRouter route. Providers charge different rates for the same model, so pinning one also pins the price.

inputs.name: providerFallbacks
inputs.label: Allow provider fallbacks
inputs.description: Fall back to other serving providers when the preferred one (the pin above, or OpenRouter's top choice) is unavailable. Off makes the call fail rather than be served and billed by someone else.

outputs.name: provider
outputs.description: Wire it into an LLM node's provider input.

then.message: OpenRouterModel '{id}' has no model; name one on the node or wire one in.
